## Integrity audit

- [ ] Raw evidence, provisional interpretation, owner judgment, and article-ready synthesis remain distinguishable.
- [ ] No claim of exhaustiveness/completeness was made without a retrieval record.
- [ ] Contradictory evidence and material uncertainty were preserved.
- [ ] Sensitive personal/community information is handled lawfully and minimally.
- [ ] The owner's actual success criteria and arguments were not silently flattened or replaced.
- [ ] Final diff contains no unrelated changes, secrets, private correspondence, or accidental data dumps.
